hints.title: Stream Numbers from 1 to n
hints.text: Iterate through integers 1, 2, ..., n in order, maintaining a pointer into target.

hints.title: Push or Push-Pop
hints.text: For each number x, emit Push. If x is present at target[idx], advance idx. Otherwise emit Pop to discard x.

hints.title: Early Stop
hints.text: Terminate as soon as all elements of target have been matched.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: target[last]: maximum value in target (<= n)
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Continuing the simulation after target is fully built generates unnecessary operations.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Simulating sequential stream with early exit runs in at most 2 * n operations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate tracks stream index and emits Push/Pop pairs for missing numbers.
